title: A zero move fixes the input head
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and every input-head position among the $n+2$ allowed positions, a move by zero leaves the position unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: the position is one of the $n+2$ allowed positions
replaced:
For any input-head position $p$ among the $n + 2$ positions of an input of length $n$,
attempting to move the head by the sign $0$ leaves the position unchanged: the clamped
move of $p$ by $0$ equals $p$.
